title: Filipino Yukon Gold Potato Gratin
description: A creamy, garlicky, and nutritious side dish inspired by Filipino cuisine, featuring Yukon gold potatoes and a crunchy gratin topping.
instructions: Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with olive oil.
Arrange a layer of potatoes in the prepared baking dish.
Sprinkle a third of the grated cheese over the potatoes.
Repeat the layering process two more times, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
In a small bowl, mix together minced garlic and a pinch of salt.
Sprinkle the garlic mixture evenly over the top layer of cheese.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
